records.title: Propensity-score matched non-randomized intervention of dietary butyrate in adult colitis
records.abstract: Non-randomized intervention cohort evaluating dietary butyrate in 120 adults with colitis.

paragraphs.text: Consecutive patients meeting inclusion criteria were matched via propensity score weighting to adjust for baseline confounders.
Outcomes were measured by blinded outcome assessors using validated Mayo scores; multiple imputation handled missing data.
Code availability: scripts are deposited on GitHub; however, unblinded exposure self-report remains a limitation.
